notes: Yardi statements in this category are about Yardi Breeze, so Breeze was read on yardibreeze.com (the pricing URL redirects to the residential features and pricing page; the home read is the Breeze product home, not yardi.com). Five Breeze pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin; the vendor's November 2024 pricing article settles Premier rates ($2 per unit standard, $1 only when bundled with screening and renters insurance on a 12-month contract) and the $0 ACH fee under a designated amount. The one yardi.com page tried (Yardi Voyager) returned HTTP 403 at the edge to the fetch tool; per the rules no other yardi.com URL was tried. Pass 2 (8 Oct): the Voyager page was read once in a real browser (redirected to /suite/voyager-suite/) and is no longer needed; it does not settle C43 (no pricing shown), C44 (mobility named only for some editions, FAQ answer collapsed, no web-based statement) or C45 (no partner count), so all three stay unverifiable. Pass 2 consistency check: C19 (CAM reconciliation Premier-only) and C20 (commercial needs Premier) stay wrong, each contradicted explicitly and like with like on the commercial features page and the FAQ (the Breeze home page comparison table, whose check icons are in the page HTML but not the text snapshot, also checks Automated CAM reconciliation and Owner payments and reports for both tiers); C21 (owner portals need Premier) is re-classed from wrong to unverifiable because the page shows a standard 'secure portal' for owner reports but no named owner portal, and Premier-only investor portals (Investment Manager add-on). Pass 2 completeness: the gap lines and the comparison-table cells for Yardi Breeze repeat claims already coded for the same answers (est. cost, $1 per unit, minimums, free trial, per-unit, support); not coded: the q3 Claude run 1 cell 'Unit Minimum | Varies' (non-specific; the FAQ says there is no unit minimum), 'Starting Price | Varies' (q5 Claude 2), 'eSignatures | Limited', the property-type support lists (capability lines), closed-platform characterisations and rating cells, and the q10 Google AI Overviews run 2 '$15/month' line, which is about another vendor. Cause tracing read three cited pages: bcsolut carries the Premier-only CAM statement; the relayhumancloud page rendered no text; the Buildium comparison blog did not carry the owner-portal or commercial statements. Mere name mentions of Yardi, Breeze, Premier and Voyager, positioning (best for, unit ranges), feature descriptions, ratings, market share and the closed-platform characterisations without a named product were not coded. The full answer text was read for Breeze-headed sections and the Yardi Breeze column of the q8 comparison tables, which the passages file omits.
